values.description: API host — no trailing slash. PORT is set by apps/api process.env.PORT (default 3001).
Email of the seeded test user. Must exist in the local database before running the collection.
Password for the seeded test user. Min 8 chars (SignupDto constraint). Do NOT commit real passwords here.
CUID/UUID of an existing Tenant row in the local database. Required by all /supply-items routes via x-tenant-id header.
CUID/UUID of an existing SupplyCategory row belonging to the above tenant. Required by the Create Supply Item body field categoriaId.
RES-226 — Email used for forgot-password and resend-verification requests. Must match a user that exists in the local database.
RES-226 — Raw reset token extracted from the password-reset email URL. Set manually before running Reset Password requests.
RES-226 — 6-digit OTP from the verification email. Set manually before running Verify Email requests.
RES-226 — New password used in the Reset Password body. Must be at least 8 characters.
MES tenant for x-tenant-id on POST /api/mes/auth/login (local/dev seed only)
Synthetic cédula for seeded MES OWNER (local/dev only — never use in production)
Synthetic PIN for seeded MES OWNER (local/dev only)
Synthetic cédula for seeded MES OPERATOR (local/dev only)
Synthetic PIN for seeded MES OPERATOR (local/dev only)
MES JWT access token — set by MES Auth / Login Owner
MES JWT refresh token — set by MES Auth / Login Owner
Operational user id — set from JWT sub or GET /api/mes/auth/me
